title: Kettlebuilding Hybrid
author: Roam Rez
desc:
Kettlebuilding Calisthenics is a high-output, 4-day hybrid split built for lifters who want to maximize hypertrophy and athletic power without joint wear or redundant setups. By combining density-based kettlebell work, deep-stretch calisthenics, heavy sled conditioning, and targeted isolation, this routine delivers maximum stimulus with zero fluff.

Day 1 (Upper Power & KB Complex): Explode through weighted vertical pulling, heavy overhead pressing, and a high-volume kettlebell shoulder complex.

Day 2 (Pull, Push & Carry): Build thick lats, upper chest volume, and anti-rotational core stability through heavy gorilla rows, bodyweight paralysis push-ups, pullovers, and loaded carries.

Day 3 (Sled, KB Legs & Posterior): Bulletproof your knees and load your posterior chain with sled conditioning, heavy kettlebell lunges, 90 lb Roman chair extensions, and ATG split squats.

Day 4 (Arms & KB Shoulder Power): Isolate the arms and finish strong with heavy JM presses, Meadows curls, pinwheel curls, and a dynamic kettlebell shoulder flow.
